quarterly_data.quarter: Furukawa Electric TDnet: Sale of Investment Securities, Expected Recognition of (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company revised its consolidated forecast for the first half (interim period) of the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 (announced August 6, 2026): net sales JPY 720,000 million, operating profit JPY 49,500 million and ordinary profit JPY 60,500 million unchanged; profit attributable to owners of parent raised to JPY 58,000 million from JPY 42,500 million (+36.5%), because the gain on the sale of part of its UACJ Corporation shares (approximately JPY 22.0 billion, extraordinary income) is now expected in the second quarter instead of in or after the third quarter. No change to the full-year consolidated forecasts. Previous first half (FY ended March 31, 2026): net sales JPY 610,658 million, operating profit JPY 19,134 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 FY3/2027 forecast: net sales JPY 720,000 million, OP JPY 49,500 million (unchanged); net profit JPY 58,000 million (from 42,500 million); full year unchanged
